description: Created for the hardwood but taken to the streets, the Nike Dunk Low Retro returns with crisp overlays and original team colours. This basketball icon channels '80s vibes with premium leather in the upper that looks good and breaks in even better. Modern footwear technology helps bring the comfort into the 21st century.

The allure of city nights meets the ease of retro athletic wear in these adidas shoes. Suede details accent the coated leather upper, and a terry collar lining provides a soft step. An ultralight Lightstrike midsole cushions your stride as you traverse the streets, while the semi-translucent outsole makes an undeniable style statement.

Inspired by Michael Jordanâs alma mater, the Off-White x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG âUNCâ carries a classic two-tone composition, filtered through Virgil Ablohâs unique design prism. The process involves taking a white leather base with dark powder blue overlays and adding embellishments that convey an expressive, handmade quality. They include detached Wings, a floating Swoosh, and lines of text on the medial-side quarter panel delineating the taxonomy of the shoe.

The radiance lives on in the Nike Air Force 1 '07, the b-ball icon that puts a fresh spin on what you know best: crisp leather, bold colours and the perfect amount of flash to make you shine. A subtle platform gives you just the right amount of height.

Inspired by Michael Jordanâs alma mater, the Off-White x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG âUNCâ carries a classic two-tone composition, filtered through Virgil Ablohâs unique design prism. The process involves taking a white leather base with dark powder red overlays and adding embellishments that convey an expressive, handmade quality. They include detached Wings, a floating Swoosh, and lines of text on the medial-side quarter panel delineating the taxonomy of the shoe.

Made in collaboration with Virgil Ablohâs luxury streetwear brand, the Off-White x womenâs Air Jordan 4 Retro SP âSailâ delivers a subdued take on the classic silhouette. The deconstructed leather build is rendered in a monochromatic Off-White finish, complete with semi-translucent TPU detailing on the molded eyelets, structural âwingsâ and Nike Air-branded heel panel. Ablohâs signature flourishes include a tonal zip tie and âAIRâ printed above the visible Air sole unit.

Inspired by the national teamâs away kit, the Nike Mercurial Superfly 7 Elite FG âKoreaâ features tiger stripes on a one-piece Flyknit upper, overlaid with durable NikeSkin and enhanced with All Conditions Control technology for a reliable touch in both wet and dry conditions. The lace-up is equipped with a stiffer chassis, complete with a Nike Aerotrak zone on the forefoot plate for superior traction on the pitch.

The Nike Mercurial Superfly 7 Elite SE FG Jadon Sancho brings style and performance together. Designed by Nike, this soccer cleat honors Jadon Sancho with its sleek design and vibrant blue color. Made for elite players, the Mercurial Superfly 7 features innovative technology to deliver explosive speed and agility on the field. Perfect for those who want to stand out and dominate the game.

Released in July 2019, the Nike Mercurial Superfly 7 Elite SE FG 'Laser Orange' continues the line of high-performance Mercurial cleats that first debuted in 1998. This edition features a Dynamic Fit Flyknit upper with micro-textured NIKESKIN and an All Conditions Control (ACC) coating. Below, aggressive graphic elements and iridescent, chevron-shaped studs add style and substantial traction on firm-ground fields.

The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake Black is a special edition sneaker released as part of a collaborative effort between Nike and Canadian rapper and musician Drake that was included in the NOCTA collection. The Nike NOCTA Glide features a black and white color scheme with a significant part of the upper appearing in black while the midsole is white and the outsole is translucent grey with a touch of orange on the underfoot. It also has carbon-inspired mudguards running across both side panels and a white chunky midsole providing reinforcement on the shoe. Some of the branding details on the shoe include Nike branding on the eyestays and the NOCTA trident logo and glossy NOCTA badges on the tongue. What our experts love about the Nike NOCTA Glide Drake Black is the contemporary design. The carbon-inspired mudguards add a unique style to the shoes while the pods on the midsole offer structural support. The shoes were initially released at the retail price of $160 on the 29th of June, 2023.

Low `Out of office` sneakers in white with grey arrow at side. Off-Whiteâ¢ logo at back. Grey and white rubber soles. White lace-up closure.Virgil AblohâOff-Whiteâs founder and creative directorâwanted to create a tennis shoe with a late 1980âs and early 1990âs aesthetic, that could be worn all-day-every-day. The result: a low-top silhouette with hybridized street, basketball and running influences. The âOUT OF OFFICEâ sneaker features a contrasting outsole with translucent gel insets, classic perforated toe vamps, a ribbed heel and a recontextualized logo.

An integral part of Virgil Abloh's debut Nike collaboration titled The Ten, the Nike Blazer Mid Off-White reflects Abloh's appreciation for reconstruction in design. This Blazer features a leather and mesh off-white upper with oversized Swoosh overlays that overlap the midsole and a grey Durabuck heel tab. On the medial side of the upper, the signature Off-White return address graphic is stamped. From there, a yellowed sole provides a vintage aesthetic.

The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 âArzarethâ features vibrant blue tones on a breathable knit upper, its side panels overlaid with a semi-translucent RPU cage for added structure and durability. Contrasting black is applied to the sneakerâs bootie-style collar, good for a snug fit around the ankle. The sneaker rides on a PU encapsulated EVA midsole, reinforced underfoot by a herringbone rubber outsole for grippy traction.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 is a combination of heritage functionality and Kanye West's unorthodox design style. Launched in September 2019, this Magnet version is engineered with a neoprene, suede and leather build in a palette of grey gradients. Reflective accents remain at the heel for visual interest in low light. The sculpted Boost-filled midsole flaunts defined pops of color while gum rubber for the outsole exudes throwback appeal.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 âCreamâ delivers an unassuming colorway of Kanye Westâs running-inspired silhouette. The upper features rolled knit construction in a pale grey hue, reinforced with tonal no-sew skins and tan nubuck overlays. An off-white finish distinguishes the exaggerated EVA midsole, featuring sculpted sidewalls that conceal a full-length drop-in Boost unit. Underfoot, the rubber outsole uses a classic herringbone traction pattern for superior grip.

The Yeezy QNTM Teal Blue features a marbled olive Primeknit upper with teal blue and dark grey accents woven in. Unlike the performance model, this lifestyle design does not feature additional TPU caging on the upper for a more relaxed fit. A black reflective heel, dark grey toe guard, and translucent white sole midsole complete the design.

With his streetwear background and impressive catalog with Nike through his Off-Whiteâ¢ label, the late designer took the world by storm when he debuted his elusive Louis Vuitton Nike Air Force 1 by Virgil Abloh. And with the collection slated to expand, the French brand has just given us a sneak peek at how the shoes were made.
